search.howSearchWorksFederation: Wafrn connects with the fediverse and bluesky. You can search tags "tumblr style" but for better results we recommend using "twitter style" for fandoms.

prerequisites.label: Prerequisites
prerequisites.intro: Migrating from Bluesky is relatively easy, but requires your attention!
prerequisites.outOfTheWay: Let's get some prerequisites out of the way:
prerequisites.hostedAccountWarning: If you're currently using a wafrn-hosted bsky account, it will be nuked.
prerequisites.supportWarning: This doesn't always go smoothly! If any issues occur, reach out to the wafrn team!
prerequisites.handleMove: If you are using a .bsky.social handle, it will be moved to .{{pdsUrl}}
prerequisites.pdsWarning: You cannot use your own PDS. You will be using the Wafrn-hosted one.

unlinking.label: Unlinking and deleting the old account
unlinking.intro: First off, we must unlink (and delete) your previous linked bluesky account. This is the Wafrn-hosted one, if you have one.
unlinking.inviteCodeInfo: This will also give you an "invite code", that we'll use in the next steps to move over your existing account. Please write it down!
unlinking.deleteAndGetCode: Delete bsky associated account and get invite code
unlinking.gotCode: Got the code? Alright, on to the next step.

pdsMoover.label: PDSMoover - Actually moving the account
pdsMoover.intro: Now we'll use an external migration tool, called PDS Moover to do the actual migration part.
pdsMoover.providerUrl: For the provider, give them this URL:
pdsMoover.followInstructions: Follow their instructions closely. If something goes wrong, reach out to the Wafrn team and your site admin!
pdsMoover.useInviteCode: And of course, give PDS Moover the invite code that you wrote down
pdsMoover.wroteItDown: You wrote it down, right? If not, go back.

linking.label: Linking the account to Wafrn
linking.intro: If the "MOOVE" went alright, we'll now need to link up the migrated account to Wafrn.
linking.createAppPassword: To do this, we log in to the newly migrated account as if it was any other Bluesky account on bsky.app, and create an "App Password"
linking.appPasswordLocation: You'll find the relevant options in Settings > Privacy and Security > App Passwords
linking.formIntro: Once you've grabbed a new app password, put it in together with the new username here:
linking.appPasswordLabel: App Password (NOT YOUR PASSWORD, A BLUESKY APP PASSWORD)

profit.label: Profit?
profit.done: Hooray! All should be done! Please verify on your profile that the bluesky handle is visible. Your old Bluesky posts should also start appearing on your profile.
profit.support: If there was any issues, please reach out!The Wafrn team and admins of your site are happy to help :)

reportList.advancedHelpIntro: You can add advanced filters by prefixing filter keywords in the following list with plus sign + as an additive filter or minus sign - as a subtractive filter. Select filters are separated from their value by either a colon : or equal sign =, for example +target:EvilUser. Select filters can be used implicitly as additive filters without a plus sign +.
reportList.advancedHelpLogic: Additive filters are OR within their category but AND with different keywords. Subtractive filters are AND with themselves and other keywords.
reportList.keywordReporter: r or reporter (Select) URL of the user who reported the target
reportList.keywordTarget: t or target (Select) URL of the user who was reported
reportList.keywordResolved: d or resolved (Flag) whether a report was resolved
reportList.exampleUnresolved: -r=ReportSpammer -d filters to unresolved reports not sent by ReportSpammer
reportList.exampleReporter: +reporter=Vigilante r:VigilanteAlt -target=EvilUser filters to only reports of user EvilUser that were sent by Vigilante or VigilanteAlt
